entry.title: XRIA Lab at IEEE ISMAR 2026: co-organizing XR-SPro and presenting two workshop papers

link.title: XRIA Lab at IEEE ISMAR 2026: co-organizing XR-SPro and presenting two workshop papers

entry.content:
Kaveh Amouzgar is co-organizing the XR-SPro 2026 workshop on extended reality for smart production, held on 6 October 2026 as part of IEEE ISMAR 2026 in Bari, Italy.

XRIA Lab contributes two workshop papers to the program:

From XR-Captured Demonstrations to Evidence-Grounded Operator Assistance: A Reasoning Layer for Human–AI Symbiosis
Kaveh Amouzgar, Eric Dario Márquez León, Masoud Rahimigorji, and Cedric Kaneza
Paper Session 1: AI-Enhanced XR Systems and Human–AI Assistance in Smart Production

An expert’s narrated assembly demonstration, recorded with an XR headset, is turned into an enriched procedural knowledge graph with inferred requirements, validation status, and provenance. This graph grounds an LLM assistant that answers novice operators’ questions, so its guidance can be traced back to evidence. The work is part of the ARTISAN project.

A Non-Intrusive XR Interaction Stack for Monitoring, Programming, and Simulating Collaborative Robots in Smart Production
Kaveh Amouzgar, Simon Arnestrand, Oscar Rosengren, Elis Amcoff, and Erik Hultman
Paper Session 2: XR Interaction, Robot Collaboration, and Immersive Training, plus the hands-on demo session

A HoloLens 2 application connects to a UR3 collaborative robot in an existing learning-factory production cell without modifying its PLC or robot logic. Operators can position the robot with a holographic target box, author multi-step programs, monitor joint temperatures and motion trails, test programs on a digital twin, and export them as URScript.

IEEE ISMAR 2026

entry.title: XRIA Lab joins the RESILIENT Competence Centre with FLEXIVA

link.title: XRIA Lab joins the RESILIENT Competence Centre with FLEXIVA

entry.content:
Together with Scania and the USER – Uppsala Smart Energy Research group, XRIA Lab is joining the extension of the RESILIENT Competence Centre for Resilient Energy Systems for 2027–2031.

Our project, FLEXIVA, tackles the barriers to industrial energy flexibility: where the flexibility potential lies in production, what it takes to provide it within operational constraints, and when it makes economic sense. FLEXIVA will recruit a postdoctoral researcher; see Join Us.

entry.title: MANUFACTOR kicks off, our first Horizon Europe project

link.title: MANUFACTOR kicks off, our first Horizon Europe project

entry.content:
The Horizon Europe project MANUFACTOR starts today and runs until April 2029. XRIA Lab joins 13 partners across Europe to build a multi-agent platform that combines XR, multi-agent AI, human digital twins, and multimodal sensing for cognitive and physical augmentation of industrial operators and managers.

entry.title: Two new Vinnova projects start, ARTISAN and AI-COMPETE

link.title: Two new Vinnova projects start, ARTISAN and AI-COMPETE

entry.content:
XRIA Lab starts two new three-year projects funded by Sweden’s Innovation Agency (Vinnova).

ARTISAN develops agentic XR training that captures expert knowledge and guides new operators on the shop floor, together with AugmentedRealm, Hitachi Energy, Solme, and Ekets Group.

AI-COMPETE develops a multi-agent AI decision-support system that aligns production planning with renewable energy availability, together with the University of Skövde, Volvo Penta, Scania, Daloc AB, and Evoma AB.

At the same time, the education project PUMA2025 starts, bringing XR into machine design teaching at Uppsala University.
entry.summary: XRIA Lab starts two new three-year projects funded by Sweden’s Innovation Agency (Vinnova).
